name: Car Listing Check
description: Checks vehicle listings that you supply (title, description, structured vehicle fields, photo metadata) and returns a completeness score 0-100, missing fields and up to five prioritised fixes; also returns listing checklists for Germany, the US, the UK or a generic market. Read-only, no authentication; photo URLs are never fetched, no scraping, no vehicle-fact verification or valuation.
author: AI Car Video
